assumptions: 'Success rate' means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.
caveats: Success rate depends on the denominator: attempt-level 93.1%, order-level 95.5%, technical 96.8%. Retries and drop-offs explain the gap.

The data-quality scan flagged missing issuer IDs on Meridian Bank card attempts in August 2026 (8.0%). This does not affect the UPI figure directly, but issuer-level views for that scope are understated.

facts.text: UPI attempt success rate for 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31 was 93.1%: 184,077 successful attempts out of 197,696 attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt.
The same UPI traffic shows an order-level success rate of 95.5% (181,222 of 189,760 orders) and a technical success rate of 96.8% (184,077 of 190,115).
The three definitions are up to 3.71pp apart, with attempt-level the lowest at 93.1% and technical the highest at 96.8%.
The data-quality scan found one warning, on Meridian Bank card attempts in August 2026: 8.0% (2,856 of 35,507) have no issuer ID. This is a card scope, not UPI.

response.headline: The UPI attempt success rate in August 2026 was 93.1%, with 184,077 successful attempts out of 197,696 total attempts.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Count orders with at least one failed attempt followed by a successful attempt, and compare that against the difference between attempt-level and order-level failures.
hypotheses.rationale: Order-level success is higher than attempt-level success, and every retry is counted as its own attempt in the attempt-level denominator.
hypotheses.text: The gap between the attempt-level rate (93.1%) and the order-level rate (95.5%) is likely driven by customers retrying failed UPI payments and eventually succeeding, so some failed attempts sit inside orders that ended up successful.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The same UPI traffic shows an order-level success rate of 95.5% (181,222 of 189,760 orders) and a technical success rate of 96.8% (184,077 of 190,115).
recommendations.rationale: The headline number moves by up to 3.71pp depending on the denominator, so an unlabelled figure can be misread.
recommendations.text: Quote the UPI success rate together with its definition (attempt-level 93.1%, order-level 95.5%, technical 96.8%) in reports and dashboards.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The gap between the attempt-level rate (93.1%) and the order-level rate (95.5%) is likely driven by customers retrying failed UPI payments and eventually succeeding, so some failed attempts sit inside orders that ended up successful.
recommendations.rationale: This would confirm or reject the retry explanation for the attempt-versus-order gap.
recommendations.text: If the retry effect matters for decisions, break down UPI failures by retry behaviour to see how many failed attempts are later recovered.
